results.name: dashboard: empty state, no invented statistics before any data
create flow: details → preview → review → confirm → session code
live update: wallet approval reaches the open session page as DEMO_ACCEPTED, five trust layers, no protocol claim
many sessions: KPI tile opens the filtered list; search, status filter and sort agree with the API
results: outcome summary and filter; pending sessions excluded
cancel needs confirmation; a cancelled session refuses a late citizen decision
expiry: open session moves to EXPIRED on its own; a late decision is refused
organisation isolation: org B sees none of org A sessions, details, results or activity
network failure: last good data stays with a notice and retry; recovers when the API returns
keyboard: create flow completes without a mouse and focus moves to the review step
axe WCAG 2.2 AA on every TASK-10 state, light and dark
responsive RTL: 320–1366 px and 200 % text without horizontal scroll
reduced motion: no element animates or transitions
